run_train_net: run the VLPart training script with a config file and optional test datasets
build_model_from_cfg: build a detectron2 model from a VLPart configuration object
create_evaluator: create an evaluator for a dataset based on its evaluator type metadata
test_model_on_datasets: test a trained model on configured test datasets and print CSV results
setup_vlpart_config: setup a detectron2 config with VLPart defaults and merge from a YAML file
